title: What makes an SEO progress report useful to a trade business
body:
Read the fictional six-week journal and its follow-up queue. Which entries explain the work clearly, and where would you need more evidence? Please do not post customer details, account exports or private reports. [SEO for Tradespeople](https://seofortradespeople.co.uk/) maintains the journal. We welcome improvements that make work and observations easier to distinguish.

Start with the [README](https://github.com/SEO-For-Tradespeople/local-seo-change-journal#readme), then run the documented example locally.
